mission: Informative findings about part families (dimensions, snap groups, effects). NOT placement law. Do NOT use these as pre-script placement rules — placement authority lives in the validated mechanics (CONNECTED_PIECE_CURVATURE_GRAMMAR, WALL_SHELL_ENCLOSURE_RECIPE, FOCAL_BUILD_GEOMETRY_STRATEGY_PROTOCOL, C_TRIFLOOR_EDGE_CONTACT_GRAPH_PROTOCOL, CONTINUOUS_PATH_ASSEMBLY_RULE, AUTHORITATIVE_SNAP_PLACEMENT_PROTOCOL, PART_PLACEMENT_MAP_SCHEMA). Effect/use findings are also catalogued in the creative index.

families.status: validated for stone; likely for related short-wall families by shared role/extents
families.critical_failure: Correct tangent orientation still leaves gaps when radius/count/scale are arbitrary.
families.orientation_rule: Horizontal rings: rz = angle + 90 so long axis follows ring tangent.
families.dimension_rule: Use the specific part's FBX extent_x as visible tangential length basis unless in-game calibration overrides it.
avoid: hidden subterrain rings with no visible effect
ring-only pads used as proof of final-body fit

families.status: validated for S_WALL/S_WALLM; use FBX plus project-specific calibration for others
rules: Do not compress wall centers arbitrarily.
Do not stack vertical wall tiers at guessed increments.
Use explicit visible_bottom/visible_top targets when burying or stacking wall rings.
S_CHEV_WALL has much deeper protrusion than S_WALL/S_WALLM; use selectively for relief.
B_SHL_E is the red glow source.
B_DECO_P does not create the red glow.
Hide/recess/bury B_SHL_E bodies where possible.
Use as red lens, eye, beacon, iris, oculus, crown, or reactor glow.
Avoid exposed dense fields of identical shield bases.
weak_current_uses: overbuilt wall wreath with visible bases

families.status: validated in-game effect; invisible in Blender
families.effect: orange dotted/solid beams plus triangular orange/pink fan plane
rules: Use as hidden beam projector, not decorative body.
Evaluate in-game.
Best current arrangement is circular scanner/oculus ring.
Needs architectural framing to avoid looking like loose beams.

families.effect: temporary blue electric/glitch visual effect after load-in, fades after roughly 5–10 minutes
rules: Use B_WNG_A specifically when electricity is required.
Can be buried inside geometry.
Do not require it to be visible.
Architecture must still read after effect fades.

Do not continue density testing past n192 unless requested.

n135 underside-up half-buried oculus is a separate locked experimental option.

families.rule: When wall scale changes, recalculate facade and trim offsets from scaled FBX dimensions and push overlays outward from the scaled visible face.
families.never: Do not reuse FACE_OFF, FACADE_PUSH, ring radius, or trim span constants after changing part scale unless they are re-derived from scaled dimensions.
families.source: prior macro-wall cleanup macro-wall cleanup review

rules: Use center_y/extent_y to compute bottom/top placement
Do not assume visible center origin

families.scope: trim, wall rows, cornice bands, rings
rules: Do not label trim continuous unless it touches/overlaps
Compute centers from visible scaled length and overlap
Add end/corner closures where needed

families.scope: large landmark facades using arches/half arches
rules: Use scale over quantity for grand facades
Build connected arch/half-arch assemblies
Avoid dense small cylinder/detail fields until macro read is correct
Follow exact user-requested compositions before interpretive variants

families.scope: wall or half-wall pieces used as dome/shell surface tiles
rules: Do not place wall shells as vertical cylinder bands
Orient local X as ring tangent, local Y as profile meridian/up, local Z as outward normal
Use chord spacing and taper ring count with radius
Macro silhouette and connected masses before micro details
Use larger scaled parts when they improve recognition
Micro details only after major read is correct

families.lesson: Half arches are handed; mirrored sides require explicit RZ handedness table per facade.
checks: pull outward from macro wall face
families.placement_authority_superseded_by: PART_ORIENTATION_OVERRIDES (do not assume mirror handedness; verify per part)

families.lesson: Orient dome wall panels to tangent/meridian/normal surface frames rather than vertical rings.

members.role: circular macro room / rotunda / topper mass
square macro room / penthouse block / pod / roof adapter

rules: Use as structural fabric, not decoration.
Do not only stack rooms vertically.
Create distinct silhouettes through offsets, pods, overhangs, bridges, receivers, cranes, dishes, and layered modules.
Attach antennas/spires to visible mounts or room tops.
Use color deliberately for function/district identity.
Avoid repeating red lens band + antenna crown + stacked room as the default topper pattern.
failure_modes: topper not integrated to roof interface
validation: check all antennas/details visibly mount to room geometry

members.role: cargo rack / conveyor cassette / machine module

rules: Robotic arms require visible mounts and a target task.
Conveyor/cargo parts must read as cassettes, racks, rails, or machine modules.
Repeated conveyor modules must use consistent orientation and spacing.
Drone hives need visible docking collars, service bays, or wall racks.
Avoid sparse robot parts on a pad.
known_issues: B_WALL_CARG1 orientation can read as random barrels if no rails/cassette context is provided.
Robot arms look toy-like without mounts and task targets.
Hive drone parts look loose unless connected by service struts/collars.

rules: Antennas/spires must be mounted to visible bases, pylons, rooms, scaffolds, or tower caps.
Do not float antennas high above a structure unless the design explicitly includes a holographic suspension system.
Antenna crowns need a named function: broadcast, scanner, docking guidance, defense, weather, relay, or AI-control signal.
Vary height and role when many antennas are used, but keep them structurally connected.
failure_modes: generic antenna crowns with no role

families.rule_summary: C_TRIFLOOR is validated for phase-resolved equilateral triangular surface/solid tiling. Do not inherit this rule to Q/F variants until FBX equivalence and behavior proofs pass.
